title: Themed Crossword --- AI and Science
author: *Abhirup Mukherjee* [DPS, IISER Kolkata]
intro: This issue's crossword is inspired by the intersection of artificial intelligence and science.

ALPHAFOLD: AI that folded proteins before your laundry
ALPHATENSOR: DeepMind AI that discovered faster matrix multiplication algorithms than those designed by humans
EVO: Generative AI model developed at the Arc Institute and NVIDIA to predict genetic mutations and design entire synthetic genomes from scratch
FUNSEARCH: AI system that discovers new, human-interpretable computer programs for solving mathematical and algorithmic problems
GENCAST: Artificial intelligence-based weather forecasting model developed by Google DeepMind that predicts global weather and extreme conditions up to 15 days in advance
PYTORCH: Python-based open-source deep learning framework developed by Meta AI
RFDIFFUSION: Open-source, generative AI tool developed by the Institute for Protein Design to create custom protein structures

BACKPROPAGATION: Algorithm popularized by Geoffrey Hinton for training neural networks
DIFFUSION: Generative AI technique that creates images or other data by gradually reversing a noise-adding process.
EXOMINER: Deep learning model developed by NASA to discover and validate exoplanets from space telescope data.
GNOME: AI that utilizes deep learning to predict 2.2 million novel crystalline materials
HOPFIELD: Recurrent neural network developed in the 1980s based on energy minimization that implements associative memory
JUMPER: Computational biologist behind AlphaFold's breakthrough, Co-recipient of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry (last name)
SPINGLASS: Disordered magnetic systems whose energy landscape inspired Hopfield networks and modern ideas in neural computation.
